name: Bhashiva, the Desert Tigress
canonNotes: The White Tiger who leads the Tiger Warriors of Cathay, revered as the greatest fighter and leader of her people in generations.
Her tribes came west across the Mountains of Heaven and swore loyalty to Zhao Ming, the Iron Dragon.
voiceNotes: Fierce, proud and loyal; speaks of oaths, the hunt and her people.
Honours her word and those who keep theirs.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
